### Experiment Details
- **Experiment Number:** (e.g., Experiment 01)
- **Topic / Tool:** (e.g., FTK Imager / WinPmem)
- **Host Operating System:** (e.g., Windows 11 / Kali Linux 2024.1)

### Description
Describe your question, observation, or proposed improvement clearly.

### Expected Behavior / Clarification Needed
What was expected or what concept requires additional explanation?

### Screenshots or Error Logs
If applicable, paste terminal errors or screenshots to provide context.
